recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a vertical rectangular photograph with a rough, torn-paper edge on the right, set against a solid olive-green background. The typography is clustered in the upper right quadrant, utilizing bold, clean sans-serif fonts in white and lime green.
coreVisualRelationships: The torn paper edge creates a tactile boundary between the photographic subject and the graphic background.
The lime green text complements the olive green background while providing high contrast for readability.
The vertical orientation of the photo frame balances the horizontal weight of the large-scale typography.
coreInvariants: Torn-edge paper effect on the photographic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A vertical photo frame occupies the left third of the composition, featuring a group portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white sans-serif text in the upper right serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large white text, moves up to the smaller green header, then down to the secondary green text, and finally left to the photographic subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the bottom right provides breathing room and emphasizes the asymmetrical layout.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green (secondary text and top/bottom borders)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-value, high-saturation accents for a vintage print feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family pairing using color and scale for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal lines separating text blocks
Double-headed arrow banner at the top

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the display text.
Provides the clean, neutral geometric structure required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid olive-green background. On the left side, place a vertical rectangular photo frame with a rough, hand-torn paper edge on its right side. Add a thin lime-green border at the very top and bottom. At the top center, place a thin black double-headed arrow with the word 'STEREO' in a small, wide sans-serif font in the middle of the line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three blocks of text in the upper right. The top block is lowercase lime-green sans-serif. The middle block is large uppercase white sans-serif. The bottom block is lowercase lime-green sans-serif. Ensure all text is left-aligned and tightly kerned.

verificationChecks: Is the background a muted olive green?
Does the photo frame have a visible torn-paper texture on the right edge?
Is the primary text white and the secondary text lime green?
Is the 'Stereo' banner present at the top with arrows?

adjustableVariables: Width of the torn-paper photo frame
Scale of the white display text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the torn edge looks organic and not like a straight vector line.
Ensure the lime green text is legible against the olive background.
Verify the 'Stereo' text at the top is small and wide-spaced.
Confirm the overall composition feels like a 1960s vinyl record sleeve.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, torn-edge photo element with a solid-color field and bold, multi-colored geometric sans-serif typography for a mid-century editorial look.
